description: A jQuery plugin that creates a switch widget using radio buttons, supporting accessibility and customizable options.

methods.name: __init
methods.description: Initializes the radio switch widget, creating DOM elements and binding events.

methods.name: __doSwitch
methods.description: Internal method to switch the widget state between 'on' and 'off'.

methods.name: doSwitch
methods.description: Public method to change the switch state and trigger change event if needed.

methods.name: doEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables the entire widget.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the widget, including 'on'/'off' and enabled/disabled.
